doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Pontiac childhood, family and piano training
title: Father's lifelong job with General Motors; birth in Vicksburg
summary: His father worked for the companies that became General Motors; Jones was born in Vicksburg, not Pontiac.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, your father worked for General Motors?

He worked for General Motors for all of his life. At first the company was called Bodett Brothers, then it was called Fishbodies, then it was called Yellow Truck and Coach, then it was called General Motors. You see, General Motors absorbed all of these other companies. But, he worked there all of his life.
Now he came from Vicksburg, Mississippi?
Vicksburg, Mississippi, that’s where I was born.
